comparison_rules.normal: Both STATEMENT_DIGEST_TEXT results normalize to SELECT ? WHERE ? = ? after whitespace normalization.
comparison_rules.same_target_anomaly: Second digest retains an extra minus before final placeholder.
comparison_rules.case_gates: metadata_difference; no wrong_result or crash inference.
comparison_rules.unknown: Syntax/unsupported feature errors, failed setup/postcheck, timeouts/OOM/connection errors, mismatching environment, uncomparable plan or any other unexplained result are unknown; never normal.
comparison_rules.conclusion: Previous normal plus validated target abnormal => observed_new_at_release; same anomaly on previous => pre_existing; otherwise unknown.
